coordinateConvention: MIRRORED_NATIVE_PIXEL_CENTERS; normalized model x becomes (1-x)*639, y becomes y*479; reference boxes unchanged.

definitions.spatialAssessment: Only inclusive coarse rectangle containment and Euclidean distance lower bound to rectangle: hypot(max(left-x,0,x-right),max(top-y,0,y-bottom)). No center point, RMS, exact coordinate GT, inferred error inside the rectangle, or interpolated endpoint. Lower bound zero is consistent with the subjective box, not proved exact correctness.
definitions.primarySemanticCohort: tipVisibility=VISIBLE AND anatomicalDigit=INDEX AND pointingIntent=POINT. Report all source denominators, available, missing, with/without reference box. Also report VISIBLE+INDEX any intent separately. A rectangle with unresolved visibility/anatomy does not create index/pointing truth.
definitions.rawSelection: Landmark8 only from exactly one returned hand, finite and within normalized [0,1]. Zero hands, multiple hands, invalid or off-frame coordinates are missing; no label-guided hand choice. This anatomical landmark availability is not pointer semantic classification.
definitions.freshMeasurement: Use canonical isFreshMeasurement with acceptance, TRACKING, current accepted point, original capture binding, oldest known pixel origin <=150ms, and temporal measurement freshness. Original historical clocks are counterfactual and do not establish actual CPU live freshness or latency.
definitions.ready: Measured output AND readiness.eligible; same point, a stricter separate availability cohort.
definitions.otherLabels: Visibility, anatomical digit, apparent pointing intent and adjacent-frame continuity remain separate. Explicit CONTRARY and NON_INDEX outputs are reported only with their exact denominators; an absent control cohort is unavailable rather than zero false-positive risk. Ambiguous/unresolved box containment is a nonsemantic diagnostic only.
definitions.pairedComparison: All retained labels. Separately report CPU availability gains/losses and classify their returned output as inside/outside/unknown box. Among both available with box, report both inside, GPU outside/CPU inside, GPU inside/CPU outside, both outside. No available-only accuracy claim, favorable label selection or independent-frame confidence intervals.
definitions.logicalBoundary: Canonical accepted nonnull ID change, initial acquisition excluded and null gaps skipped. Local IDs are not physical identities. Qualify only coarse visible-index interval continuity if every packet between last accepted old ID and first accepted new ID is annotated VISIBLE INDEX and every immediately adjacent transition is explicitly SAME_VISIBLE_INDEX. Missing/ambiguous/unresolved labels block qualification. Also report last-fresh to first-fresh interval coverage separately; no physical identity switch or recovery truth is manufactured.

limits: New reviewer was blind to prior outputs/source/metrics/references. Sampling was selected after an earlier aggregate event-coverage analysis; exposed recording and all references remain AI development, not independently sampled physical holdout.
Subjective coarse rectangles and static apparent anatomy/intent are fallible. No exact endpoint, selected physical identity or field qualification.
Repeated frames are temporally correlated. No frame-count independence or confidence interval.
No new model inference, camera, recording, label creation, source changes, threshold changes or sweep. Replay only unchanged stored raw neural packets and gray planes.
The current UI/build browser cohort is independent from this historical conditional producer comparison; do not claim new post-UI capture/performance or physical calibration from replay.
conclusion: Conditional availability and coarse-reference consistency are development observations. Unknown anatomy or continuity remains unknown; local logical replacement counts do not establish physical identity switches. No acceptance or physical correctness claim.
